headings: Strategic Priorities: Our focus for Square is reflected in three core pillars: Commerce, Automation, and Networks.
paragraphs: At Block, Inc. (together with its subsidiaries, "Block" or "we"), we are building technology that enables people and businesses to participate more fully in the economy. Our purpose is economic empowerment, helping individuals and businesses manage, move, and grow their money through simple and connected tools.

Block designs and operates connected ecosystems that integrate commerce solutions, financial services, software, hardware, and networks to serve individuals and small businesses, primarily through Cash App's consumer network and Square's business ("seller") network. Our platform integrates payments, banking, lending, and commerce solutions designed to provide secure, reliable, and scalable financial infrastructure. We apply data, automation, and AI to improve the speed, accuracy, and usability of our products.

Our ecosystem strategy connects these capabilities across both sellers and consumers. The ecosystems share common infrastructure for payments processing, risk management, identity, and data, allowing customers to access multiple products across a connected platform. We continue to invest in capabilities that enhance interoperability and efficiency, including embedded financial services, automation, and open protocols such as Bitcoin.

We started Block with the Square ecosystem in February 2009 to enable businesses to accept card payments, a critical capability that had previously been inaccessible to many businesses. As our company grew, we recognized that sellers need a broad set of integrated solutions to operate efficiently and competitively. We saw how we could apply our strength in technology and innovation to help sellers. We have since expanded Square into a comprehensive commerce ecosystem that provides more than 30 distinct products and services to help our sellers start, run, and grow their businesses. We combine commerce solutions, financial services, and bitcoin capabilities to create products and services that are cohesive, fast, self-serve, and elegant. These attributes differentiate Square in a fragmented industry that traditionally forced sellers to stitch together products and services from multiple vendors, and often rely on inefficient non-digital processes and tools. Our ability to add new sellers efficiently, help them grow their business, and cross-sell our products and services has historically contributed to our growth.

Cash App provides an ecosystem of financial products and services to help consumers manage their money. Cash App's mission is to redefine the world's relationship with money by making it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible. While Cash App started with the single ability to send and receive money, it now provides an ecosystem of commerce solutions, financial services, and Bitcoin capabilities focused on helping consumers make their money go further by enabling customers to store, send, receive, spend, invest, buy now, pay later ("BNPL"), borrow, or save their money with Cash App. Similar to our Square ecosystem, we believe the aggregation of these products into one app differentiates Cash App from competitors and provides greater utility for customers, allowing Cash App to build retentive relationships with its customers. Over time, with its bank partners, Cash App is aiming to become one of the top providers of banking services to households in the United States that earn up to $150,000 per year.

TIDAL expands our purpose of economic empowerment to artists. TIDAL is a global platform for musicians and their fans that uses unique content, experiences, and features to bring fans closer to artists and to provide artists with tools to succeed as entrepreneurs. TIDAL offers an extensive catalog of more than 250 million songs and 1,000,000 high-quality videos. TIDAL has a global presence with listeners in more than 60 countries and relationships with nearly 300 labels and distributors.

Our bitcoin ecosystem includes our bitcoin hardware projects, which include Bitkey, which is a self-custody bitcoin wallet, Proto, which is a bitcoin mining system, as well as Spiral, an independent team focused on contributing to bitcoin open source work. We believe our bitcoin ecosystem can help address inefficiencies in the current financial system, especially with respect to identity and trust. Through our bitcoin initiatives, we are developing open hardware, self-custody tools, and decentralized technologies that enable individuals to securely own and verify their digital assets, reinforcing user control and trust without reliance on traditional financial intermediaries.

Our two reportable segments are Square and Cash App, which reflects our two primary ecosystems and the manner in which the Company's chief operating decision maker ("CODM") reviews and assesses performance. Historically, we reported revenue by category, including transaction-based revenue, subscription and services-based revenue, hardware revenue, and bitcoin revenue. These categories represented the primary sources of revenue within our Square and Cash App ecosystems.

We have realigned our revenue categories to better reflect the evolution of our company. Since our initial public offering, we have grown from a payments-focused platform into a broader ecosystem that includes loan products through financial services and bitcoin-related offerings. These businesses are integral to our operations and illustrate the expanded scope of our company today. As a result, we identified three reportable revenue categories: Commerce Enablement, Financial Solutions, and the Bitcoin Ecosystem.

•Commerce Enablement empowers sellers and consumers to transact across our ecosystems. It primarily includes Square payments, software, and hardware, Cash App Card, Cash App Pay, our BNPL products, and Cash App Business. Commerce Enablement also includes TIDAL streaming and artist tools, which extend our commerce capabilities to creators.

•Financial Solutions provides banking, lending, and money management products for individuals and businesses. This primarily includes Cash App Borrow, Instant Deposit, Interest Income, Paper Money Deposits, ATM, and brokerage services, as well as Square Loans, Savings, Balances, and Square Card. Financial Solutions enables customers to access, manage, and grow their money.

•Bitcoin Ecosystem encompasses our consumer and business bitcoin products, including bitcoin buy/sell functionality in Cash App, Square Bitcoin, Proto, and Bitkey. This ecosystem reflects our efforts to make bitcoin accessible, secure, and integrated into everyday financial activity through the development of open financial infrastructure.

These revenue categories reflect how we see our business today. Each revenue category represents a distinct driver of growth and profitability within our business and is supported by shared infrastructure, including our automation and artificial intelligence platform. Together, these revenue categories generated $10.4 billion in gross profit in 2025.

Square sellers represent a diverse range of industries (including services, food-related, and retail businesses) and sizes, ranging from sole proprietors to multinational businesses. Square sellers span geographies, including the United States, Canada, Japan, Australia, the United Kingdom, Ireland, France, and Spain. We have also increasingly served mid-market sellers, which we define as sellers that generate more than $500,000 in annualized Square Gross Payment Volume ("Square GPV"), due to our ability to offer more flexible and complex solutions than traditional alternatives, as well as a growing product suite. For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, none of our customers accounted for greater than 5% of Square GPV. We define Square GPV as the total dollar amount of all card and bank payments processed by sellers using Square, net of refunds.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Our Industry
We have generated significant net losses in the past, and we intend to continue to invest in our business. Thus, our profitability may decline.
Our business depends on our ability to maintain, protect, and enhance our brands.
Our efforts to expand our product portfolio and market reach, including through acquisitions, may not succeed and may reduce our revenue growth and profitability.
Substantial and increasingly intense competition in our markets and industry may harm our business.
Developments in the cryptocurrency market subject us to additional risks.
The development and use of AI in our products may result in reputational and competitive harm and could adversely impact our business.
Operating or expanding our business globally subjects us to new challenges and risks.
We are subject to risks related to the banking ecosystem, including through Square Financial Services, our bank partnerships, and FDIC and other regulatory obligations.
Our loan products are subject to risks related to general macroeconomic conditions and increase our exposure to customer defaults.
TIDAL subjects us to risks and uncertainties related to the music industry.
paragraphs: Investing in our securities involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the section titled Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations and our consolidated financial statements and related notes, before making any investment decision with respect to our securities. The risks and uncertainties described below may not be the only ones we face. If any of the risks actually occur, our business could be materially and adversely affected. In that event, the market price of our Class A common stock could decline, and you could lose part or all of your investment.

Our business operations are subject to numerous risks and uncertainties, including those outside of our control, that could cause our actual results to be harmed, including risks regarding the following:
Risks related to our business and our industry:
•our ability to retain existing sellers and customers, attract new sellers and customers, and increase sales to both new and existing sellers and customers;
•our investments in our business and ability to maintain profitability;
•our recently announced workforce reduction and related reorganization, including the potential for increased reliance on proactive intelligence and artificial intelligence tools;

paragraphs: This management's discussion and analysis provides a review of the results of operations, key operating metrics and non-GAAP financial measures, and liquidity and capital resources of Block, Inc. on a historical basis and outlines the factors that have affected recent earnings, as well as those factors that may affect future earnings. The following discussion and analysis should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and the notes thereto included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K ("Form 10-K").

This section of this Form 10-K generally discusses fiscal 2025 compared to fiscal 2024. The comparison of the fiscal 2024 results with the fiscal 2023 results that are not included in this Form 10-K can be found in the "Management's Discussion and Analysis Results of Operations" section in the Company's fiscal 2024 Annual Report within Part II, Item 7 of Form 10-K, filed on February 24, 2025.

The statements in this discussion regarding our expectations of our future performance, liquidity, and capital resources; our plans, estimates, beliefs, and expectations that involve risks and uncertainties; and other non-historical statements in this discussion are forward-looking statements. These forward-looking statements are subject to numerous risks and uncertainties, including, but not limited to, the risks and uncertainties described under Item 1A. Risk Factors and elsewhere in this Form 10-K. Our actual results may differ materially from those contained in or implied by any forward-looking statements.

We launched the Square ecosystem in February 2009 to enable businesses ("sellers") to accept card payments, a critical capability that had previously been inaccessible to many businesses. We have since expanded to provide sellers additional products and services and to give them access to a cohesive ecosystem of tools to help them start, run, and grow their businesses. Similarly, with Cash App, we have built an ecosystem of financial products and services to help consumers manage their money. Cash App now provides an ecosystem of commerce solutions, financial services, and bitcoin capabilities focused on helping consumers make their money go further by enabling customers to store, send, receive, spend, invest, BNPL, borrow, or save their money. In addition, our nascent ecosystems include TIDAL as well as Bitcoin, which includes businesses such as Proto and Bitkey.

In 2025, we generated gross profit of $10.4 billion, up 17% year over year. Cash App generated gross profit of $6.3 billion in 2025, up 21% year over year, primarily driven by growth in Cash App Borrow. Square generated gross profit of $3.9 billion in 2025, up 9% year over year, driven by financial solutions, most notably Square Loans.

In 2025, operating income was $1.7 billion and Adjusted Operating Income was $2.1 billion, compared to operating income of $892.3 million and Adjusted Operating Income of $1.6 billion in 2024. Net income attributable to common stockholders was $1.3 billion compared to net income attributable to common stockholders of $2.9 billion for the same period in 2024, and Adjusted EBITDA was $3.5 billion, an increase of 14% year over year. Net income for 2025 and 2024 included a loss of $55.9 million and gain of $420.9 million, respectively, from the remeasurement of our bitcoin investment. In 2024, we released our valuation allowance associated with certain federal and state deferred tax assets, as well as recognized deferred tax assets as part of internal legal entity restructuring efforts, which resulted in benefits to net income for 2024 of $1.9 billion. Refer to the Key Operating Metrics and Non-GAAP Financial Measures section below for reconciliations of non-GAAP financial measures to their nearest generally accepted accounting principles ("GAAP") equivalents.

Starting in 2023, we sharpened our focus on our organizational structure and expenditures with a view to identifying areas where we can be more cost efficient as we focus on disciplined growth. We made progress on our cost efficiency goals in 2025, and we expect to continue these efforts. For the year ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, we recorded $78.6 million and $26.8 million of severance and other expenses related to these efforts, respectively. In February 2026, we announced a workforce reduction restructuring plan (the "Workforce Plan") designed to better align our organizational structure with our operating model and strategic priorities. As part of the Workforce Plan, we expect to reduce our current workforce by more than 40%. We expect that the execution of the Workforce Plan will be substantially complete by the end of the second quarter of fiscal 2026. We will continue to incur expenses, including additional restructuring costs, in the short term to implement these initiatives. We expect to realize benefits related to our focus on disciplined growth and cost efficiencies, and we expect to continue to benefit from these actions in future periods. We plan to continue to operate at this smaller size and are continuing to look at ways to improve our efficiency through a combination of AI automation, prioritization of our scope, performance management, and centralization of teams and functions to reduce duplication.

During the third quarter of 2025, we issued $2.2 billion in aggregate principal amount of senior unsecured notes comprised of $1.2 billion in aggregate principal amount of senior notes due 2030 ("2030 Senior Notes") and $1.0 billion in aggregate principal amount due 2033 ("2033 Senior Notes"). We ended 2025 with $9.2 billion in available liquidity, with $8.4 billion in cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash, and investments in marketable debt securities, as well as an undrawn amount of $775.0 million available under our revolving credit facility, which was amended on January 14, 2026 to, among other things, increase the unsecured revolving loan facility to $900 million. This represents a decrease of $1.5 billion from the end of 2024, primarily due to a $1.0 billion cash payment for the settlement of the outstanding 2025 Convertible Notes that matured in March 2025 and $2.3 billion of share repurchases in 2025, partially offset by $2.2 billion cash received related to the issuance of the 2030 Senior Notes and 2033 Senior Notes.

In November 2025, the board of directors of the Company authorized an increase to the Company's share repurchase program to repurchase up to an additional $5 billion of the Company's Class A common stock, for a total authorization of $9 billion. The goal of the program is to return capital to shareholders. The timing and amount of shares repurchased will depend on a variety of factors, including the stock price, business and market conditions, corporate and regulatory requirements, alternative investment opportunities, acquisition opportunities, and other factors. As of December 31, 2025, we have repurchased $3.7 billion of our Class A common stock under the program, of which $2.3 billion was purchased in 2025.

Commerce enablement revenue is primarily comprised of revenue generated from Square payments, software, and hardware, Cash App Card, Cash App Pay, the Company's BNPL products, Cash App Business accounts, and TIDAL. Commerce enablement revenue also includes various other software as a service ("SaaS") products offered through Square. Our other SaaS products include subscription fees on our vertical software solutions, operational tool products (including Square Team Management and Square Payroll), and other products.

We charge our sellers a transaction fee that is generally calculated as a percentage of the total transaction amount processed. We also selectively offer custom pricing for certain larger sellers. We also charge transaction fees to Cash App Business customers for peer-to-peer transactions or funding transactions with a credit card.

Cash App Card offers Cash App customers the ability to use their stored funds via a Visa prepaid card that is linked to the balance the customer stores in Cash App. We also earn interchange fees when a Cash App Card is used to make a purchase. These transaction and interchange fees are treated as revenue when charged.

Revenue from our BNPL products include merchant fees generated from consumer receivables, late fees, gift cards, and certain affiliate and advertising fees. Through the use of our BNPL products, consumers can pay for their purchases over time by splitting their purchase price generally into three or four installments, typically due in two-week increments, without paying fees (if payments are made on time). For the majority of our BNPL products, we do not charge consumers interest or fees, other than late fees, which may be charged in certain regions as an incentive to encourage consumers to pay their outstanding balances as and when they fall due. We also offer the ability for consumers to pay for larger transaction sizes over a three-, six-, twelve-, or twenty-four-month period using a monthly payment option, which includes no late fees and no compounding interest with a cap on total interest owed. We may sell the rights, title, and interest to a third-party investor for an upfront consideration subsequent to origination of some of the loans. We are retained by the third-party investor to service the loans and earn a servicing fee for facilitating the repayment of these loans through our payments solutions.

TIDAL primarily generates revenue from subscriptions to customers, and such subscriptions allow access to the song library, video library, and improved sound quality. Customers can subscribe to services directly from the TIDAL website or through the Apple store. For both subscription channels, we charge customers a monthly fee for those subscription services.

戰略優先事項：Square 的重點反映在三個核心支柱：商業、自動化與網路。
paragraphs: Block, Inc.（含其子公司，簡稱「Block」或「本公司」）正在開發技術，使個人與企業能更充分參與經濟活動。本公司之目的為經濟賦能，協助個人與企業透過簡單且連結的工具，管理、運用與增長其資金。
Block設計並運作連結生態系統，整合商業解決方案、金融服務、軟體、硬體與網路，以服務個人與小型企業，主要透過Cash App的消費者網路與Square的企業（「賣家」）網路。本公司平台整合付款、銀行、貸款與商業解決方案，以提供安全、可靠且可擴展的金融基礎設施。本公司運用數據、自動化與人工智能，以提升產品的處理速度、準確性與易用性。
本公司生態系統策略將這些能力連結至賣家與消費者。這些生態系統共享付款處理、風險管理、身分認證與數據的共同基礎設施，使客戶能透過連結平台存取多種產品。本公司持續投資提升互通性與效率的能力，包括內嵌式金融服務、自動化與開放協議如比特幣。

本公司於2009年2月以Square生態系統啟動Block，以協助企業接受信用卡付款，這是一項對許多企業而言此前無法取得的關鍵能力。隨著本公司成長，我們認知到賣家需要一套廣泛的整合解決方案，以有效且具競爭力地運作。我們看見如何運用本公司在科技與創新上的優勢，協助賣家。自那之後，本公司已將Square拓展為一個完整的商業生態系統，提供超過30種不同的產品與服務，協助賣家啟動、運作與成長其業務。我們結合商業解決方案、金融服務與比特幣能力，以創造具有一致性、快速、自服務且優雅的產品與服務。這些特質使Square在一個傳統上迫使賣家從多個供應商拼湊產品與服務、並常依賴低效率非數位流程與工具的碎片化產業中脫穎而出。本公司能有效增加新賣家、協助其成長業務並交叉銷售產品與服務的能力，歷來已貢獻於本公司成長。

Cash App提供一個金融產品與服務的生態系統，協助消費者管理其資金。Cash App的使命為重新定義人們與錢的關係，使其更貼近、瞬間可用且普遍可及。雖然Cash App最初僅具備傳送與接收資金的單一功能，但現今已提供一個商業解決方案、金融服務與比特幣能力的生態系統，專注於協助消費者讓其資金發揮更大效益，使客戶能透過Cash App儲存、傳送、接收、花費、投資、立即購入、後付（"BNPL"）、借款或儲蓄其資金。與我們的Square生態系統相似，我們認為將這些產品整合至單一應用程式，使Cash App與競爭對手區隔，並為客戶提供更高的實用價值，使Cash App能建立具有留存性的客戶關係。隨著時間推移，透過其銀行合作夥伴，Cash App旨在成為美國年收入高達15萬美元家庭的主要銀行服務提供者之一。
TIDAL將本公司經濟賦能的宗旨拓展至藝人。TIDAL是一個全球平台，為音樂人及其粉絲所用，透過獨特的內容、體驗與功能，使粉絲更接近藝人，並為藝人提供工具使其成為企業家。TIDAL提供超過2.5億首歌曲與100萬部高品質影片的廣泛曲庫。TIDAL在全球擁有超過60個國家的聽眾，並與近300家唱片公司與發行商建立關係。

本公司比特幣生態系統包含本公司比特幣硬體專案，包括Bitkey，這是一款自保管比特幣錢包；Proto，這是一款比特幣挖礦系統；以及Spiral，這是一個獨立團隊，專注於貢獻比特幣開放原始碼工作。我們認為本公司比特幣生態系統能協助解決現有金融體系的低效率，特別是在身分與信任方面。透過本公司比特幣專案，我們正在開發開放硬體、自保管工具與分散式技術，使個人能安全地擁有並驗證其數位資產，強化用戶控制與信任，而無需依賴傳統金融中介機構。
本公司兩個應報告分部為Square與Cash App，這反映本公司兩個主要生態系統，以及本公司首席營運決策者（"CODM"）審查與評估績效的方式。歷來，我們按類別報告收入，包括基於交易的收入、基於訂閱與服務的收入、硬體收入與比特幣收入。這些類別代表本公司Square與Cash App生態系統內的主要收入來源。
我們已重新調整我們的營業收入類別，以更準確反映本公司業務的演進。自我們首次公開發行股票以來，我們已從一個以支付為核心的平台，成長為一個更廣泛的生態系統，包含透過金融服務提供的貸款產品以及與比特幣相關的產品。這些業務是我們運作的重要組成部分，並說明瞭本公司目前的擴展範圍。因此，我們確定了三個應報告的收入類別：商業啟動、金融解決方案以及比特幣生態系統。
•商業啟動賦予賣方與消費者在我們生態系統中進行交易的能力。其主要包含Square支付、軟體與硬體、Cash App Card、Cash App Pay、我們的BNPL產品以及Cash App Business。商業啟動也包含TIDAL串流與藝人工具，這些工具將我們的商業能力延伸至創作者。
•金融解決方案為個人與企業提供銀行、貸款與財務管理產品。這主要包含Cash App Borrow、即時存款、利息收入、紙鈔存款、ATM與證券交易服務，以及Square Loans、儲蓄、餘額與Square Card。金融解決方案使客戶能夠存取、管理並成長其資金。
•比特幣生態系統包含我們的消費者與企業比特幣產品，包括Cash App內的比特幣買賣功能、Square Bitcoin、Proto與Bitkey。這個生態系統反映我們努力使比特幣變得更易用、更安全，並整合至日常金融活動中，透過開發開放的金融基礎設施。
這些收入類別反映我們對目前業務的看法。每個收入類別代表我們業務中成長與獲利的獨特驅動因素，並由共享基礎設施支持，包括我們的自動化與人工智慧平台。這些收入類別在2025年共同產生了104億美元的毛利率。

Square賣方代表多樣化的產業（包括服務業、餐飲業與零售業）與規模，從獨資企業到跨國企業不等。Square賣方分佈於多個地理區域，包括美國、加拿大、日本、澳洲、英國、愛爾蘭、法國與西班牙。我們也越來越服務中型企業賣方，我們定義為年化Square毛利率支付量（"Square GPV"）超過50萬美元的賣方，這是因為我們能提供比傳統替代方案更靈活且複雜的解決方案，以及日益增長的產品組合。截至2025年12月31日、2024年12月31日與2023年12月31日，我們的客戶中，沒有任何客戶的Square GPV佔比超過5%。我們定義Square GPV為賣方使用Square處理的所有卡與銀行支付總金額，扣除退款後的淨額。

paragraphs: 本項管理層討論與分析提供對 Block, Inc. 過去財務表現、關鍵營運指標與非 GAAP 財務指標、流動性與資本資源的總覽，並說明影響近期獲利的因素，以及可能影響未來獲利的因素。以下討論與分析應與本年度 10-K 申報表所附之合併財務報表及其附註一併閱讀。
本項 10-K 申報表之此節一般討論財政 2025 年與財政 2024 年之比較。財政 2024 年與財政 2023 年之比較資料（未包含於本項 10-K 申報表中）可於本公司財政 2024 年年度報告之「管理層討論與分析 業務表現」節中找到，該節為 Part II, Item 7 之 10-K 申報表，於 2025 年 2 月 24 日提交。
本項討論中關於我們對未來表現、流動性與資本資源之預期、計畫、估計、信念與預期，以及本項討論中其他非歷史性陳述，均為前瞻性陳述。這些前瞻性陳述受許多風險與不確定性影響，包括但不限於於 Item 1A. 風險因素及其他處於本項 10-K 申報表中所描述之風險與不確定性。我們實際結果可能與任何前瞻性陳述中所包含或暗示之內容有重大差異。

我們於 2009 年 2 月發佈 Square 生態系統，以協助企業（"販售者"）接受信用卡付款，這是一項對許多企業而言先前無法取得的重要功能。我們隨後擴展至為販售者提供額外產品與服務，並給予他們一個整合的工具生態系統，協助他們開設、運作與成長其企業。同樣地，透過 Cash App，我們已建立一個財務產品與服務的生態系統，以協助消費者管理其資金。Cash App 現已提供一個商業解決方案、財務服務與比特幣功能的生態系統，專注於協助消費者讓資金發揮更大效益，使客戶能儲存、轉帳、接收、消費、投資、BNPL、貸款或儲蓄其資金。此外，我們的初步生態系統包括 TIDAL 以及比特幣，其中包含 Proto 和 Bitkey 等企業。
2025 年，我們產生毛利為 104 億美元，較 2024 年成長 17%。Cash App 在 2025 年產生毛利為 63 億美元，較 2024 年成長 21%，主要受益於 Cash App Borrow 的成長。Square 在 2025 年產生毛利為 39 億美元，較 2024 年成長 9%，受益於財務解決方案，特別是 Square Loans。

2025 年，營運收入為 17 億美元，調整後營運收入為 21 億美元，與 2024 年營運收入 8.923 億美元與調整後營運收入 16 億美元相比。歸屬於普通股股東的淨利為 13 億美元，與 2024 年相同期間的 29 億美元相比，調整後 EBITDA 為 35 億美元，較 2024 年成長 14%。2025 年與 2024 年的淨利包含因比特幣投資重新衡量而產生的損失 5590 萬美元與收益 4.209 億美元。2024 年，我們釋出與某些聯邦及州稅資產延遲稅資產相關的價值準備，並在內部法律實體重整努力中認列延遲稅資產，這導致 2024 年淨利產生 19 億美元的效益。請參閱下方「關鍵營運指標與非 GAAP 財務指標」節，以瞭解非 GAAP 財務指標與其最近 GAAP 等價項的調整關係。

自 2023 年起，我們加強對組織結構與支出的關注，以識別我們在專注於嚴謹成長時可更有效率的領域。我們在 2025 年取得進展，並預期會持續這些努力。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2024 年 12 月 31 日，我們分別記錄 7860 萬美元與 2680 萬美元的遣散費及其他費用，與這些努力相關。2026 年 2 月，我們宣佈了一項員工減編重整計畫（"員工減編計畫"），旨在更好地使組織結構與運營模式及戰略優先事項對齊。根據員工減編計畫，我們預期會減少現有員工超過 40%。我們預期員工減編計畫的執行將在財政 2026 年第二季末 substantially 完成。我們預期在短期內會繼續產生費用，包括額外的重整費用，以實施這些計畫。我們預期會從專注於嚴謹成長與成本效率的行動中獲得效益，並預期會在未來期間繼續受益於這些行動。我們計畫持續以較小規模運作，並持續尋找方法透過 AI 自動化、優先考量我們的範疇、績效管理及團隊與功能的集中化以減少重複，來提高效率。

在 2025 年第三季，我們發行了總計 22 億美元的無擔保高收益票據，包含總計 12 億美元的 2030 年到期票據（"2030 年到期票據"）及總計 10 億美元的 2033 年到期票據（"2033 年到期票據"）。我們在 2025 年結束時擁有 92 億美元的可用流動性，其中包含 84 億美元的現金、現金等價物、限制性現金及市場可交易債務證券投資，以及 7.75 億美元未動用的循環信貸融資額，該信貸融資於 2026 年 1 月 14 日進行修訂，其中包括將無擔保循環貸款融資額提高至 9 億美元。這代表與 2024 年結束時相比減少 15 億美元，主要由於 2025 年 3 月到期的 2025 年可轉換票據結清現金支付 10 億美元，以及 2025 年的 23 億美元股票回購，部分抵消了 2030 年到期票據及 2033 年到期票據發行所收到的 22 億美元現金。
2025年11月，本公司董事會批准增加本公司股票回購計畫，授權回購最多額外50億美元的本公司A類普通股，總授權金額為90億美元。該計畫的目標是將資金回饋給股東。回購股票的時間與數量將取決於多種因素，包括股票價格、業務與市場狀況、公司與法規要求、替代性投資機會、收購機會及其他因素。截至2025年12月31日，我們已根據該計畫回購37億美元的本公司A類普通股，其中23億美元為2025年購入。

商業啟動收入主要由Square付款、軟體、硬體、Cash App Card、Cash App Pay、本公司之BNPL產品、Cash App Business帳戶及TIDAL所產生之收入組成。商業啟動收入亦包含透過Square所提供的各種其他軟體即服務（"SaaS"）產品。我們的其他SaaS產品包括我們垂直軟體解決方案的訂閱費用、作業工具產品（包括Square Team Management及Square Payroll）及其他產品。
我們向賣家收取交易費用，通常為處理總交易金額的百分比。我們也會針對某些較大規模的賣家提供客製化價格。我們也會向Cash App Business客戶收取交易費用，用於點對點交易或使用信用卡進行資金交易。
Cash App Card讓Cash App客戶能夠透過與客戶在Cash App中儲存的餘額連結的Visa預付卡來使用其儲存的資金。我們也會在Cash App Card用於購物時收取 interchange 費用。這些交易及interchange費用在收取時被視為收入。

我們BNPL產品的收入包括來自消費者應收款的商家費用、遲繳費用、禮品卡及某些合作夥伴與廣告費用。透過使用我們的BNPL產品，消費者可以將購買金額分期付款，通常分為三至四期，每期約為兩週，且在按時付款的情況下不收取費用。對於我們絕大多數的BNPL產品，我們不會向消費者收取利息或費用，除了遲繳費用，某些地區可能會收取遲繳費用作為鼓勵消費者按時償還應付款項的激勵措施。我們也提供消費者以每月付款方式，分期償還較大交易金額，分期期數為三、六、十二或二十四個月，此方式不收取遲繳費用且不計複利，總利息上限為一定金額。我們可能在貸款產生後，將貸款的權利、所有權及利益出售給第三方投資者，以換取現金。我們被委託為第三方投資者服務貸款，並透過我們的付款解決方案促進貸款償還，以賺取服務費用。
TIDAL主要透過客戶訂閱產生收入，而這些訂閱服務讓客戶可以存取歌曲庫、影片庫及改善的音質。客戶可以直接透過TIDAL網站或Apple商店訂閱服務。對於這兩個訂閱管道，我們向客戶收取每月費用以使用這些訂閱服務。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關的風險
我們過去已產生顯著的淨虧損，且我們有意繼續投資於我們的業務。因此，我們的獲利能力可能下降。
我們的業務取決於我們維持、保護及提升我們品牌的能力。
我們擴展產品組合及市場版圖的 endeavour，包括透過併購，可能無法成功，且可能減少我們的營收成長與獲利能力。
我們市場及產業中持續增加且激烈的競爭可能對我們的業務造成損害。
加密貨幣市場的發展使我們面臨額外的風險。
我們產品中人工智慧（AI）的發展與應用可能導致聲譽及競爭力的損害，並可能對我們的業務造成不利影響。
營運或擴展我們的業務至全球市場，使我們面臨新的挑戰與風險。
我們面臨與銀行生態系相關的風險，包括透過 Square Financial Services、我們的銀行合作夥伴以及 FDIC 及其他監管義務。
我們的貸款產品面臨與總體經濟條件相關的風險，並增加我們對客戶違約的暴露程度。
TIDAL 使我們面臨與音樂產業相關的風險與不確定性。
paragraphs: 投資本公司的證券涉及高度風險。您應謹慎考慮下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並配合本年度報告表10-K中所有其他資訊，包括「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」部分及我們的合併財務報表與相關附註，再做任何有關本公司證券的投資決定。下列所描述的風險與不確定性可能並非我們唯一面臨的風險。若任何風險實際發生，將可能對我們的業務造成重大且不利的影響。在此情況下，本公司A類普通股的市場價格可能下跌，您可能損失部分或全部投資。
我們的業務營運面臨許多風險與不確定性，包括我們無法控制的風險，這些風險可能導致我們實際結果受到損害，包括與下列相關的風險：
與我們的業務與產業相關的風險：
•我們保留現有販售者與客戶、吸引新販售者與客戶，並增加對新舊販售者與客戶銷售的能力；
•我們對業務的投資與維持獲利能力；
•我們最近宣佈的員工裁減與相關重整，包括對主動情報與人工智慧工具依賴程度增加的潛在風險；
